steps.content: Helpless to do anything but watch them disappear, Saina curses under her breath and immediately moves to give chase.
A swift, nimble figure steps in to block her path.

The aura of command emanating from the farland matriarch steals the breath from Saina's lungs. Helga is indeed leading this operation, but hatred has already burned away reason. Saina lifts her chin, meeting the elder's gaze in open defiance.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Why? If even DisCity rats dare go in there, why can't we?

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: No one survives a Tide of Ashes that strong unprepared. Are you trying to get everyone killed?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Then I'll go alone! The cowards can stay! You talk about protecting us. Where were you when our people were humiliated, sacrificed? Now you won't even chase down two rats abandoned by Fraser and cut off from DisCity!
The sudden blow leaves Saina's mind blank. When sensation returns, her right cheek burns as if struck by a cannon.
Ignoring Saina's outburst, Helga pulls two sets of protective gear from her vehicle and tosses them at her feet.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: If you're fool enough to go in there, don't you dare claim to be one of my people even if you come back alive!
Hypatia's head swims as consciousness returns. The world had spun her like a rag in a barrel. Now, as her vision steadies, she sees only endless gray mist stretching in every direction.
